# Turn on two-factor
{: .no_toc }

Enroll an authenticator app (TOTP) and save recovery codes.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `ACC-05` |
| **Route** | `/account/security/2fa/enable` · deep link `substratal://account/security/2fa/enable` |
| **Where** | Personal › Account |
| **Who can use it** | Self |
| **Kind** | wizard |
| **Available in** | All Hub apps (MVP) |
| **On Linux** | `AdwDialog` with `AdwNavigationView` pages |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Step 1 — Scan | qr + secret | POST /users/me/mfa/totp → otpauth_uri, secret | QR, "Copy setup key", "Open in authenticator" (otpauth:// link on mobile) | GtkPicture |
| Step 2 — Confirm | otp-field | body.code | 6 digits | AdwEntryRow input-purpose=digits |
| Step 3 — Recovery codes | secret-list | confirm response: 10 recovery codes | Copy all · Save as file · Print · Share (mobile); "I've saved these" checkbox gates Done | SecretReveal + GtkFileDialog/print |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Start | `POST /users/me/mfa/totp` | 409 → already enabled; close. |
| Confirm | `POST /users/me/mfa/totp/confirm` | 200 → step 3. 401 → wrong code. |

## Good to know

- **Loading, empty and error states:** Cancel before confirm leaves MFA off (no server cleanup needed)
